entities.name: FolD
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q5P922; 290 aa bacterial bifunctional FolD protein.
Catalyzes NADP+-dependent oxidation of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate, followed by cyclohydrolase conversion to 10-formyltetrahydrofolate.
Annotated as a homodimeric cytosolic enzyme in tetrahydrofolate interconversion.
Contains Pfam THF_DHG_CYH (PF00763) at residues 6–120 and THF_DHG_CYH_C (PF02882) at residues 139–284.

entities.name: Tetrahydrofolate interconversion
observations: FolD links 5,10-methylene-THF, 5,10-methenyl-THF, and 10-formyl-THF in one-carbon metabolism.
